name: claude-usage-statusbar
description: Month-to-date Claude Code spend vs. your monthly budget, an orchestration hub for every project and session, plan handoff to a fresh session with a suggested model and effort, a themed dashboard, a context meter, a waste report and opt-in token-saver hooks. Local-only, zero dependencies, no network.

commands.title: Claude Usage: Send a Plan to a New Session
Claude Usage: Set Up Plan Handoff

claudeUsage.monthlyBudgetUsd.description: Monthly budget in USD. Spend is counted from the 1st of each calendar month (local time).

claudeUsage.warnAtPercent.description: Status bar turns yellow (and a one-time notice appears) at this % of budget.

claudeUsage.criticalAtPercent.description: Status bar turns red (and a one-time notice appears) at this % of budget.

claudeUsage.notifyOnThresholds.description: Show a notification once per month when the warn and critical percentages are reached.

claudeUsage.dataDirs.description: Extra Claude Code 'projects' directories to scan (in addition to ~/.claude/projects and $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/projects). %VAR% and ~ are expanded.

claudeUsage.pricingOverrides.description: Per-model USD per million tokens, matched by substring of the model id. Example: {"opus-5": {"input": 5, "output": 25}}. Cache rates default to 1.25x/2x/0.1x of input.

claudeUsage.refreshSeconds.description: Safety-net rescan interval in seconds. File changes also trigger a refresh within a few seconds.

claudeUsage.contextWindow.description: Context window of the model you use, in tokens. Used for the context meter (ctx 142k / 200k). Set 1000000 for a 1M-context model.

claudeUsage.contextNudgeAt.description: One notice per session when its context reaches this many tokens (what each request re-sends, and what /compact or /clear would save). 0 turns the notice off.

claudeUsage.contextHintAtPercent.description: Show a 'ctx 142k' hint in the status bar once the current session's context is at least this % of the context window.

claudeUsage.showHubItem.description: Show the orchestration hub item in the status bar ('2 live', '1 waiting · 2 live'). Click it to open the hub.

claudeUsage.planHandoffPrompt.description: When the Plan Handoff hook saves a new plan in one of this window's folders, ask once whether to send it to a new Claude Code session (with a suggested model and effort).
